title: 第1107章 心祭尘第1106章 不死心的混沌莽一族
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 青丘圣地，仙霞氤氲，瑞气千条。
放眼望去，圣山上下早已是张灯结彩，喜庆非凡。
千年灵蚕丝织就的万丈红绸如龙蛇般缠绕于亭台楼阁之间，折射着天光，流光溢彩；
拳头大小、蕴含精纯月华的明珠被法力托举着，如同星辰般点缀在云端，将夜晚映照得亮如白昼；
无数珍稀灵植绽放奇花异卉，馥郁芬芳弥漫万里。
狐族上下，无论尊卑，皆面带喜色，穿梭忙碌，为半个月后那场震动整个妖域的旷世婚礼做最后的准备。
这不仅是圣女雪姒疏的终身大事，更是象征着天狐族前所未有的辉煌与强盛。
此刻，远在亿万里的东域，阴阳宗山门内。
掌门白云子捏着手中由天狐族特使送来的、散发着九尾天狐独特气息的鎏金请柬，
脸上的表情十分精彩，先是愕然，随即化作浓浓的欣慰，最后忍不住哈哈大笑起来，声震云霄。
“哈哈哈！好你个姚德龙！臭小子！当真是我阴阳宗的麒麟儿啊！”白云子捋着长须，眼中精光四射，
“先是墨阳宗圣女对其情深意重。这才多久？居然连天狐族那位眼高于顶、冰清玉洁的圣女雪姒疏也拿下了！
这桃花运……啧啧，简直是我阴阳宗历代祖师都比不上的福缘！”
他越想越觉畅快，笑声愈发洪亮：
“好啊！妙啊！墨阳宗圣女，天狐族圣女……这臭小子不声不响，就给咱们阴阳宗拉来了两个铁杆盟友！
尤其是天狐族，如今双帝坐镇，实力之强，放眼整个苍云世界也是顶尖！
这层姻亲关系，比我阴阳宗苦修千年都管用！”
他脑中闪过姚德龙那张时而惫懒、时而坚毅的脸，想起这小子临走前拍着胸脯说“掌门放心，
到时候宗门长辈得来给我撑撑场面”的样子，笑意更深。
“行！这面子必须给足！”白云子眼中闪过一丝锐利，
“这小子如今已是天狐族举足轻重的核心人物，他的大婚，就是我阴阳宗的脸面！
更是震慑四方、展示肌肉的好时机！光我去还不够分量…”
他自言自语着，身形一晃，化作一道匹练般的流光，
直射向阴阳宗深处那灵气最为浓郁、寻常弟子绝难踏足的宗门禁地。
“得请那几位老祖宗出山，好好替咱们这位‘麒麟儿’……充充场面！”
魔域，万魔山，天魔宗核心——万魔大殿。
这里与青丘的喜庆祥和截然相反。魔气翻滚如沸，阴森恐怖的气息充斥每一寸空间。
无数形态各异的魔头雕像矗立在大殿两侧，空洞的眼窝里跳跃着幽绿的鬼火。
空气粘稠得仿佛凝结的血块，带着令人作呕的腥甜。
大殿之上，宗主心无魔端坐于由无数骸骨堆砌而成的巨大魔座之中。
他身披暗紫色魔龙袍，面容俊美却异常苍白，一双瞳孔深邃如渊，
偶尔闪过血色的电光，周身散发着合体巅峰境的恐怖威压。
在他下方左右两侧，赫然坐着天魔宗的擎天柱石——天魔三祖！
左侧首位，帝魔祖帝释渊！身着一袭看似朴素、却流淌着熔岩般暗金色泽的奇异道袍。
道袍之上，没有任何繁复的纹饰，却仿佛将一片沸腾的魔渊地狱压缩其中，
暗金之色流转间，无数扭曲的面孔在其中无声嘶吼、湮灭、重生！
他静静坐着，气息若有若无，却让整个大殿的空气都为之凝滞。
半步大乘！这是足以令无数修士仰望的存在。
content_en:
The holy land of Qingqiu is filled with misty clouds and thousands of auspicious auras.
Looking around, the holy mountain is already decorated with lights and colorful decorations, making it extremely festive.
Thousands of feet of red silk woven from thousand-year-old silkworms are intertwined between pavilions and pavilions like dragons and snakes, reflecting the skylight and making them radiant;
The fist-sized pearls containing pure moonlight were held up by magic power and dotted in the clouds like stars, illuminating the night as brightly as day;
Countless rare spiritual plants bloom with exotic flowers, and their fragrant fragrance permeates thousands of miles.
Everyone from top to bottom of the Fox clan, regardless of their superiority or inferiority, were busy with their faces and were busy making final preparations for the unprecedented wedding that would shock the entire Demon Realm half a month later.
This is not only a lifelong event for the saint Xuesi Shu, but also symbolizes the unprecedented glory and strength of the Tianhu clan.
At this moment, hundreds of millions of miles away in the Eastern Region, inside the gate of Yin Yang Sect.
The leader, Bai Yunzi, held in his hand the gilt invitation sent by the special envoy of the Sky Fox Clan and exuding the unique aura of the nine-tailed Sky Fox.
The expression on his face was very exciting. First he was stunned, then turned into deep relief, and finally he couldn't help but burst into laughter, which shook the sky.
"Hahaha! You Yao Delong! You brat! You are really the Qilin'er of my Yin Yang Sect!" Bai Yunzi stroked his long beard, his eyes shining brightly,
"First, the Saint of the Moyang Sect had a deep affection for him. How long has it been since then? He even captured the Heavenly Fox Clan's high-eyed, pure Saint Xuesi Shu!
This love luck... tsk tsk, it is simply a blessing that none of the ancestors of my Yin Yang Sect can compare with! "
The more he thought about it, the happier he felt, and his laughter became louder and louder:
"Okay! Wonderful! The Saint of the Moyang Sect, the Saint of the Sky Fox Clan...this brat quietly brought two die-hard allies to our Yin-Yang Sect!
Especially the Tianhu Clan, with the two emperors now in charge, is so powerful that it is also top-notch in the entire Cangyun world!
This level of marriage relationship is more effective than my thousand years of hard training in the Yin Yang Sect! "
Yao Delong's face that was sometimes lazy and sometimes resolute flashed through his mind, and he remembered that the boy patted his chest before leaving and said, "Don't worry, Master.
When the time comes, the elders of the sect will come to support me and support the scene." His smile deepened.
"Okay! This face must be given enough!" Bai Yunzi's eyes flashed sharply,
"This boy is now a very important core figure in the Tianhu Clan, and his wedding is the face of our Yin Yang Sect!
It’s a good time to shock everyone and show off your muscles! It’s not enough for me to go alone…”
He muttered to himself, his figure swayed and turned into a stream of light,
It shoots directly towards the forbidden area of the Yin Yang Sect where the spiritual energy is the richest and where ordinary disciples can never set foot.
"We have to invite those ancestors to come out and fill up the scene for our 'Qilin'er'..."
Demon Realm, Ten Thousand Demons Mountain, the core of Tianmo Sect - Ten Thousand Demons Hall.
This place is completely opposite to the festive and peaceful Qingqiu. The demonic energy was boiling, and the eerie atmosphere filled every inch of the space.
Countless demon statues of various shapes stand on both sides of the hall, with green will-o'-the-wisps dancing in their empty eye sockets.
The air was as thick as clots of blood, with a sickly sweet taste.
Above the main hall, the sect leader Xin Wu Mo sat in a huge magic throne made of countless bones.
He was wearing a dark purple magic dragon robe, his face was handsome but extremely pale, and his pupils were as deep as the abyss.
Occasionally, bloody lightning flashed, and the whole body exuded the terrifying coercion of the peak fusion state.
On the left and right sides below him, sitting impressively were the Optimus Prime Stones of the Heavenly Demon Sect—the Third Ancestor of the Heavenly Demon!
The first person on the left is Emperor Demon Ancestor Emperor Shi Yuan! Wearing a strange robe that looks simple but has a dark golden color like lava.
There are no complicated patterns on the Taoist robe, but it seems to compress a boiling demonic hell into it.
As the dark gold color circulates, countless distorted faces roar silently, are annihilated, and are reborn!
He sat quietly, his breath vague and absent, but it made the air in the entire hall stagnant.
Half step to Mahayana! This is an existence that countless monks can look up to.
